newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values unchanged.

text.p: Nearby FOB grain and soybean basis values were unchanged on Thursday as focus shifted to Chicago where CBOT grains and oilseed futures rallied, several export sources said.
"We really didn't see much activity," one broker said. "It seems like we've switched everybody's interest back to Chicago with the bullish sentiment there today."

Brokers said they were surprised by news on Thursday that USDA will not issue export certificates for grains or oilseeds to Turkey until further notice but added the news would likely have little effect on FOB markets.
"We had heard about the problems with wheat," one broker said. "It would appear these measures are punitive."
Turkey and the United States have disagreed on acceptable levels of ergot, a disease that affects wheat. USDA halted export certificates for wheat about two weeks ago.
